If sentiment is positive (≥0.67) in the last 3 days, reduce forecast by 0.5–1.5% for early horizon (1–7 days) to avoid overreaction.

If sentiment is negative (≤0.33) in the last 3 days, increase forecast by 0.5–1.5% for mid horizon (8–15 days) to counteract pessimism.

If sentiment is neutral (0.33–0.67) and price is trending upward, shift forecast downward by 0.5–1.0% in late horizon (16–30 days) to prevent overcorrection.

If sentiment spikes to 1.00 or -1.00 within 2 days, adjust forecast by ±1.0–2.0% in the same direction for the next 5-day window to align with sentiment momentum.

If sentiment is consistently low (≤0.33) over 5+ days, reduce forecast by 1.0–2.0% across all horizons to reflect bearish sentiment persistence.

If sentiment is consistently high (≥0.67) over 5+ days, increase forecast by 1.0–2.0% across all horizons to reflect bullish sentiment persistence.
